hypothesis: The ECALL commit/halt path is broken: ID decodes ECALL, but the is_ecall flag is not carried through every pipeline register into WB (or WB gates halted/exit_code on the wrong valid/bit), so a committed ECALL never sets halted. Execution therefore runs past the end of the loaded program image; the front-end keeps fetching default/out-of-image words and WB keeps retiring them, so the TB emits the endless tail of 't13_dft — retire PC/instruction does not match the loaded program' lines and never observes halted, burning the full 20 s budget. The mismatch stream starting after the last valid program word (rather than from the first fetch) distinguishes this from the previously applied fetch-handshake, request-hold and PC-capture hypotheses.
constraints: Keep the frozen top-level rv32i5 port list and module boundaries unchanged.
ECALL is recognized only by the exact instruction word 32'h0000_0073; do not halt on any other opcode or on a bubble.
Only WB may set halted/exit_code, and only for a committed ECALL; halted must be sticky and freeze PC fetch, imem_valid and further retire pulses once set.
Do not alter branch/JAL/JALR resolution, forwarding priority, load-use stall timing or reset semantics while fixing the ECALL flag path.
Synchronous active-low reset; halted/exit_code/dbg_retire_valid must be 0 during reset and before the first reset edge.
Single-cycle imem/dmem model: no extra wait states or registered responses may be introduced.
verification_targets: After the committed ECALL retires, halted becomes 1 within one clock and exit_code reflects the architectural value; simulation ends well under the 20 s cap.
No dbg_retire_valid pulse occurs after halted is asserted, and no retire PC/instruction pair is reported beyond the loaded program image.
For every retirement up to the ECALL, dbg_retire_pc/dbg_retire_insn match the loaded program word at that PC, so t13_dft no longer logs 'retire PC/instruction does not match the loaded program'.
The ECALL instruction itself retires with the correct PC and instruction word, and its is_ecall bit remains 1 through ID/EX, EX/MEM and MEM/WB.
rejected_hypotheses: Attempt 4 (branch_predictor outputs not consumed by IF and missing dmem-wait overlap) was applied but the timeout persists.
Attempt 5 (imem-ready gating deadlock pinning imem_addr=0x0c) was applied but the timeout persists.
Attempt 6 (missing registered dmem request/hold causing D-memory request changed before ready) was applied but the timeout persists.
Attempt 7 (missing held fetch-request state / imem request changed before ready) was applied but the timeout persists.
Attempt 8 (extra fetch register lagging imem_rdata by one cycle) was applied but the timeout persists.
Attempt 9 (PC carried alongside an instruction off by one, using pc+4) was applied but the same retire-mismatch/timeout failure persists, so the PC bookkeeping is no longer the primary mechanism.
